source:
set source {rename auto_import savedPrelude; namespace eval A {proc p {} {}; namespace export p}; namespace eval B {namespace import ::A::p}}
set code [catch {uplevel #0 $source} value]
puts [list code $code value $value]
puts [list imported [namespace origin ::B::p] local [info commands ::A::p]]

set source {namespace eval lib {}; namespace eval other {}; namespace eval a {namespace path ::lib; list ONE}; namespace eval b {namespace path ::other; list TWO}}
set code [catch {uplevel #0 $source} value]
puts [list code $code value $value]
puts [list a [namespace eval a {namespace path}] b [namespace eval b {namespace path}]]
